notes: Robinhood Chain 4663; LaunchFactory route. src/LaunchToken.sol has no constructor arguments: 1000000000000000000000000000 atomic units minted once to the deploying factory, plain untaxed transfers, no privileged minting or admin switches. PVP_MINIMUM_HOLDING=50000000000000000000000; isPvpEligible checks balance >= threshold only. The game server must check it with a fresh wallet signature at each queue entry; it grants no session or transfer approval. src/CabalFundingHook.sol has the six listed arguments in declaration order. $owner resolves to 0x4251627b712762b6e81799698a05c6c9dff35c5d, also the immutable treasury. Mine permission mask 0x20cc. beforeInitialize requires PoolManager as caller and $factory as sender, fee 12500 and an IMD currency, then permanently binds the full PoolKey. The factory supplies the CABAL countercurrency and tickSpacing 60; verify the final constructor bytes and bound pool. Policy and allocation are separate from this technical manifest. deployment/launch-terms.json requires poolBps=8800 and remainderTo=0x4251627b712762b6e81799698a05c6c9dff35c5d: 88% pool, 10% swarm through MerkleDistributor, 2% remainder; preserve factory LP custody/platform rules. Policy 30 defaults are 80/10/10, so the explicit launch allocation must be frozen separately. Public policy/capabilities and on-chain reads rechecked 2026-10-19: policy 30, 2500 IMD opening valuation, fee 12500 and 0.5 IMD request price unchanged. initialPrice is the required reference value; the deployer derives the opening price from policy cap, supply and token ordering. Seed is single-sided CABAL, not a 2500 IMD deposit; no custom-token cap override. Immutable official-pool custom tax is 4% buys/4% sells, entirely in IMD; wallet transfers and unrelated pools are untaxed. Exact-input buys: floor(gross IMD input/25); exact-input sells: floor(gross pool IMD output/25); exact-output buys: add ceil(required pool IMD input/24); exact-output sells: add ceil(requested net IMD output/24). Atomic rounding/full-fill checks remain. ERC-6909 claims redeem through harvest; cumulative requests=floor(totalHarvested*7/10), remainder to fixed treasury. A 1000 IMD taxable base yields 40 fees, 28 requests and 12 treasury. Prefunding/donations go 100% to requests. Separate 1.25% pool fee has 80% requester/20% network allocation outside that split; execution is not a flat all-in 5.25% quote. Swaps need no oracle, payout, worker or reserve. No rewards, dividends, snapshots, ETH conversion or bridging. Only the worker pays oracle.request@oracle-1 through immutable Intake, with no callback or arbitrary action/payee. Unique keys, expiry, per-request/UTC-day caps, exact current price/approval/debit and allowance clearing remain. Deploy with paymentsEnabled=false and worker unset; owner only configures worker, caps and enablement after review. No tax/split/treasury/intake changes, sweep, trading pause or upgrade. Changed capability pricing halts the worker. Payment proves neither off-chain admission nor a verdict; retired immutable action/Intake can strand reserves. Separate Node worker retains durable SQLite journal, coordinator lease, signed bytes persisted before broadcast, deduplication, receipt reconciliation, reorg/ambiguity halt, bounded gas and low-fund stops, settled unsigned maintenance recovery and atomic balance-read/reservation admission. Reserve eight decisions per BO5 before admission: 4 IMD, or 64 IMD for sixteen matches, plus operating reserve. Project hosts/integrates the worker; launch does not run it. Owner funds IMD and native Robinhood ETH separately; tax volume guarantees no funding. Existing tests, review limits and prepared artifacts: reports/, ADAPTATION.md, deployment/. Local evidence is not independent audit, admission or live deployment; no server hosting is included.
